training.selection: Fixed before fitting; no test tuning, no learned transformations, no class balancing. Monotonic directions encode the reviewed experimental premise that adding positive variable expenses at unchanged receipts and budget must not reduce risk.

boundary_coverage: Two training roots per archetype deliberately cover guest, area, duration and required-margin endpoints; hypothetical design anchors, not observations
outcome_shocks: Reuse v2 ordinary cost and receipts multipliers; common paired draws within each root; all new allowances variable, not supplier locked
experimental_choices: All sampling ranges and optional amounts are hypothetical scenario-design choices, not observed Sri Lankan market statistics. Baseline source prices and financial rules are reused without modification.
limitations: Shared source profiles and spatial/cost rules; no unseen-provider validation
Stage fixed at demo 4x6m, not observed CAD
Expense names ignored by model; only aggregate monetary exposure/count is learned
Same hypothetical shock mechanism for core and optional costs
Uncalibrated synthetic risk scores; no validated real-world probabilities
Health score remains an experimental financial rule, not this ML output
No date-to-future-price forecasting or vendor anomaly classifier
